```isabelle
theory RSF_Complete
  imports Main "HOL-Library.Monad_Syntax" "HOL-Library.IEEE_Floating_Point"
begin

datatype err = 
  InvalidDimension | InvalidLayerCount | TooLarge | NonFinite | 
  InvalidConfig | ShapeMismatch | DataLengthMismatch | NotInitialized | 
  NumericFailure | BadFileFormat | UnsupportedVersion

datatype 'a result = Ok 'a | Err err

definition bind :: "'a result ⇒ ('a ⇒ 'b result) ⇒ 'b result" where
  "bind m f = (case m of Ok x ⇒ f x | Err e ⇒ Err e)"

definition return :: "'a ⇒ 'a result" where
  "return x = Ok x"

fun is_ok :: "'a result ⇒ bool" where
  "is_ok (Ok _) = True" |
  "is_ok (Err _) = False"

fun get_ok :: "'a result ⇒ 'a" where
  "get_ok (Ok x) = x"

fun get_err :: "'a result ⇒ err" where
  "get_err (Err e) = e"

type_synonym f32 = "32 float"

definition is_finite_f32 :: "f32 ⇒ bool" where
  "is_finite_f32 x = (¬ is_nan x ∧ ¬ is_infinity x)"

definition clamp_finite :: "f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "clamp_finite x = (if is_finite_f32 x then x else 0)"

definition f32_add :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_add x y = plus_float RNE x y"

definition f32_mul :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_mul x y = times_float RNE x y"

definition f32_div :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_div x y = divide_float RNE x y"

definition f32_sub :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_sub x y = minus_float RNE x y"

definition f32_exp :: "f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_exp x = (let r = real_of_float x in float_of RNE (exp r))"

definition f32_sqrt :: "f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_sqrt x = sqrt_float RNE x"

definition f32_clip :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_clip v min_val max_val = (
    if is_less_float v min_val then min_val 
    else if is_less_float max_val v then max_val 
    else v)"

definition f32_lt :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ bool" where
  "f32_lt x y = is_less_float x y"

definition f32_eq :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ bool" where
  "f32_eq x y = (x = y)"

definition f32_zero :: f32 where
  "f32_zero = 0"

definition f32_one :: f32 where
  "f32_one = 1"

definition f32_from_nat :: "nat ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_from_nat n = float_of RNE (real n)"

record tensor_shape =
  dims :: "nat list"

definition shape_2d :: "nat ⇒ nat ⇒ tensor_shape" where
  "shape_2d r c = ⦇ dims = [r, c] ⦈"

definition is_2d :: "tensor_shape ⇒ bool" where
  "is_2d s = (length (dims s) = 2)"

definition rows :: "tensor_shape ⇒ nat" where
  "rows s = (if is_2d s then dims s ! 0 else 0)"

definition cols :: "tensor_shape ⇒ nat" where
  "cols s = (if is_2d s then dims s ! 1 else 0)"

definition shape_len :: "tensor_shape ⇒ nat" where
  "shape_len s = (if is_2d s then (rows s) * (cols s) else 0)"

record tensor =
  shape :: tensor_shape
  data :: "f32 list"

definition valid_tensor :: "tensor ⇒ bool" where
  "valid_tensor t = (is_2d (shape t) ∧ length (data t) = shape_len (shape t))"

definition assert_2d_and_len :: "tensor ⇒ err result" where
  "assert_2d_and_len t = (
    if ¬ is_2d (shape t) then Err ShapeMismatch
    else if length (data t) ≠ shape_len (shape t) then Err DataLengthMismatch
    else Ok ())"

definition tensor_zeros :: "nat ⇒ nat ⇒ tensor" where
  "tensor_zeros r c = ⦇ shape = shape_2d r c, data = replicate (r * c) f32_zero ⦈"

definition tensor_index :: "tensor ⇒ nat ⇒ nat ⇒ f32" where
  "tensor_index t i j = (data t) ! (i * cols (shape t) + j)"

definition tensor_set :: "tensor ⇒ nat ⇒ nat ⇒ f32 ⇒ tensor" where
  "tensor_set t i j v = t ⦇ data := list_update (data t) (i * cols (shape t) + j) v ⦈"

fun matrix_transpose :: "f32 list list ⇒ f32 list list" where
  "matrix_transpose [] = []" |
  "matrix_transpose ([] # _) = []" |
  "matrix_transpose xss = map hd xss # matrix_transpose (map tl xss)"

definition to_matrix :: "tensor ⇒ f32 list list" where
  "to_matrix t = (
    let r = rows (shape t); c = cols (shape t)
    in map (λi. map (λj. data t ! (i * c + j)) [0..<c]) [0..<r])"

definition from_matrix :: "f32 list list ⇒ tensor" where
  "from_matrix m = (
    let r = length m; c = (if r > 0 then length (hd m) else 0)
    in ⦇ shape = shape_2d r c, data = concat m ⦈)"

definition tensor_transpose :: "tensor ⇒ tensor" where
  "tensor_transpose t = from_matrix (matrix_transpose (to_matrix t))"

fun dot_product :: "f32 list ⇒ f32 list ⇒ f32" where
  "dot_product [] [] = f32_zero" |
  "dot_product (x#xs) (y#ys) = f32_add (f32_mul x y) (dot_product xs ys)" |
  "dot_product _ _ = f32_zero"

fun matrix_vector_mul :: "f32 list list ⇒ f32 list ⇒ f32 list" where
  "matrix_vector_mul [] _ = []" |
  "matrix_vector_mul (r#rs) v = dot_product r v # matrix_vector_mul rs v"

fun matrix_mul :: "f32 list list ⇒ f32 list list ⇒ f32 list list" where
  "matrix_mul a b = (
    let b_t = matrix_transpose b
    in map (λrow. map (dot_product row) b_t) a)"

definition tensor_matmul :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor" where
  "tensor_matmul a b = from_matrix (matrix_mul (to_matrix a) (to_matrix b))"

definition tensor_add :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor result" where
  "tensor_add a b = (
    if shape a ≠ shape b then Err ShapeMismatch
    else Ok (a ⦇ data := map (λ(x, y). f32_add x y) (zip (data a) (data b)) ⦈))"

definition tensor_sub :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor result" where
  "tensor_sub a b = (
    if shape a ≠ shape b then Err ShapeMismatch
    else Ok (a ⦇ data := map (λ(x, y). f32_sub x y) (zip (data a) (data b)) ⦈))"

definition tensor_div :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor result" where
  "tensor_div a b = (
    if shape a ≠ shape b then Err ShapeMismatch
    else if list_ex (λx. f32_eq x f32_zero) (data b) then Err NumericFailure
    else Ok (a ⦇ data := map (λ(x, y). f32_div x y) (zip (data a) (data b)) ⦈))"

definition tensor_clip :: "tensor ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ tensor" where
  "tensor_clip t min_val max_val = t ⦇ data := map (λx. f32_clip x min_val max_val) (data t) ⦈"

definition tensor_exp :: "tensor ⇒ tensor" where
  "tensor_exp t = t ⦇ data := map f32_exp (data t) ⦈"

definition tensor_clamp_finite :: "tensor ⇒ tensor" where
  "tensor_clamp_finite t = t ⦇ data := map clamp_finite (data t) ⦈"

definition tensor_copy :: "tensor ⇒ tensor" where
  "tensor_copy t = t"

definition tensor_pointwise_mul :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor result" where
  "tensor_pointwise_mul a b = (
    if shape a ≠ shape b then Err ShapeMismatch
    else Ok (a ⦇ data := map (λ(x, y). f32_mul x y) (zip (data a) (data b)) ⦈))"

record rsf_layer_config =
  clip_min :: f32
  clip_max :: f32
  seed_offset :: nat
  grad_mean :: bool

definition default_rsf_layer_config :: rsf_layer_config where
  "default_rsf_layer_config = ⦇ 
    clip_min = float_of RNE (-5), 
    clip_max = float_of RNE 5, 
    seed_offset = 0, 
    grad_mean = True ⦈"

record rsf_layer =
  s_weight :: tensor
  t_weight :: tensor
  s_bias :: tensor
  t_bias :: tensor
  s_weight_grad :: tensor
  t_weight_grad :: tensor
  s_bias_grad :: tensor
  t_bias_grad :: tensor
  dim :: nat
  layer_clip_min :: f32
  layer_clip_max :: f32
  layer_grad_mean :: bool

definition rsf_layer_init_with_config :: "nat ⇒ rsf_layer_config ⇒ rsf_layer result" where
  "rsf_layer_init_with_config d cfg = (
    if d = 0 then Err InvalidDimension
    else if ¬ is_finite_f32 (clip_min cfg) ∨ ¬ is_finite_f32 (clip_max cfg) then Err NonFinite
    else if ¬ f32_lt (clip_min cfg) (clip_max cfg) then Err InvalidConfig
    else 
      let fan_sum = f32_add (f32_from_nat d) (f32_from_nat d);
          xavier = f32_div (f32_sqrt (float_of RNE 6)) (f32_sqrt fan_sum);
          sw = tensor_zeros d d;
          tw = tensor_zeros d d;
          sb = tensor_zeros 1 d;
          tb = tensor_zeros 1 d;
          swg = tensor_zeros d d;
          twg = tensor_zeros d d;
          sbg = tensor_zeros 1 d;
          tbg = tensor_zeros 1 d
      in Ok ⦇ s_weight = sw, t_weight = tw, s_bias = sb, t_bias = tb,
              s_weight_grad = swg, t_weight_grad = twg, s_bias_grad = sbg, t_bias_grad = tbg,
              dim = d, layer_clip_min = clip_min cfg, layer_clip_max = clip_max cfg,
              layer_grad_mean = grad_mean cfg ⦈)"

definition rsf_layer_init :: "nat ⇒ rsf_layer result" where
  "rsf_layer_init d = rsf_layer_init_with_config d default_rsf_layer_config"

definition rsf_layer_zero_gradients :: "rsf_layer ⇒ rsf_layer" where
  "rsf_layer_zero_gradients layer = layer ⦇
    s_weight_grad := tensor_zeros (dim layer) (dim layer),
    t_weight_grad := tensor_zeros (dim layer) (dim layer),
    s_bias_grad := tensor_zeros 1 (dim layer),
    t_bias_grad := tensor_zeros 1 (dim layer) ⦈"

definition assert_pair :: "rsf_layer ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ nat result" where
  "assert_pair layer a b = (
    case assert_2d_and_len a of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok () ⇒
    case assert_2d_and_len b of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok () ⇒
    if cols (shape a) ≠ dim layer ∨ cols (shape b) ≠ dim layer then Err ShapeMismatch
    else if rows (shape a) ≠ rows (shape b) then Err ShapeMismatch
    else if length (data (s_bias layer)) ≠ dim layer ∨ length (data (t_bias layer)) ≠ dim layer then Err ShapeMismatch
    else if ¬ is_finite_f32 (layer_clip_min layer) ∨ ¬ is_finite_f32 (layer_clip_max layer) then Err NonFinite
    else if ¬ f32_lt (layer_clip_min layer) (layer_clip_max layer) then Err InvalidConfig
    else Ok (rows (shape a)))"

definition add_bias_batch :: "tensor ⇒ f32 list ⇒ nat ⇒ nat ⇒ tensor" where
  "add_bias_batch t bias batch_size dim = (
    let new_data = map (λi. 
      let b = i div dim; d = i mod dim
      in f32_add (data t ! i) (bias ! d)) [0..<length (data t)]
    in t ⦇ data := new_data ⦈)"

definition mul_pointwise_batch :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ nat ⇒ nat ⇒ tensor" where
  "mul_pointwise_batch t1 t2 batch_size dim = (
    let new_data = map (λi. f32_mul (data t1 ! i) (data t2 ! i)) [0..<length (data t1)]
    in t1 ⦇ data := new_data ⦈)"

definition rsf_layer_forward :: "rsf_layer ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor × tensor) result" where
  "rsf_layer_forward layer x1 x2 = (
    case assert_pair layer x1 x2 of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok batch_size ⇒
    let x2_t = tensor_transpose x2;
        s_x2_t = tensor_matmul (s_weight layer) x2_t;
        s_x2 = tensor_transpose s_x2_t;
        s_x2_bias = add_bias_batch s_x2 (data (s_bias layer)) batch_size (dim layer);
        s_x2_c1 = tensor_clamp_finite s_x2_bias;
        s_x2_clip = tensor_clip s_x2_c1 (layer_clip_min layer) (layer_clip_max layer);
        s_x2_c2 = tensor_clamp_finite s_x2_clip;
        s_x2_exp = tensor_exp s_x2_c2;
        s_x2_c3 = tensor_clamp_finite s_x2_exp;
        x1_new = mul_pointwise_batch x1 s_x2_c3 batch_size (dim layer);
        x1_t = tensor_transpose x1_new;
        t_x1_t = tensor_matmul (t_weight layer) x1_t;
        t_x1 = tensor_transpose t_x1_t;
        t_x1_bias = add_bias_batch t_x1 (data (t_bias layer)) batch_size (dim layer);
        t_x1_c = tensor_clamp_finite t_x1_bias
    in case tensor_add x2 t_x1_c of 
         Err e ⇒ Err e 
       | Ok x2_new ⇒ Ok (x1_new, tensor_clamp_finite x2_new))"

definition check_exp_invertible :: "tensor ⇒ bool" where
  "check_exp_invertible t = list_all (λv. ¬ f32_eq v f32_zero ∧ is_finite_f32 v) (data t)"

definition rsf_layer_inverse :: "rsf_layer ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor × tensor) result" where
  "rsf_layer_inverse layer y1 y2 = (
    case assert_pair layer y1 y2 of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok batch_size ⇒
    let y1_t = tensor_transpose y1;
        t_y1_t = tensor_matmul (t_weight layer) y1_t;
        t_y1 = tensor_transpose t_y1_t;
        t_y1_bias = add_bias_batch t_y1 (data (t_bias layer)) batch_size (dim layer);
        t_y1_c = tensor_clamp_finite t_y1_bias
    in case tensor_sub y2 t_y1_c of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok y2_new_pre ⇒
    let y2_new = tensor_clamp_finite y2_new_pre;
        y2_t = tensor_transpose y2_new;
        s_y2_t = tensor_matmul (s_weight layer) y2_t;
        s_y2 = tensor_transpose s_y2_t;
        s_y2_bias = add_bias_batch s_y2 (data (s_bias layer)) batch_size (dim layer);
        s_y2_c1 = tensor_clamp_finite s_y2_bias;
        s_y2_clip = tensor_clip s_y2_c1 (layer_clip_min layer) (layer_clip_max layer);
        s_y2_c2 = tensor_clamp_finite s_y2_clip;
        s_y2_exp = tensor_exp s_y2_c2;
        s_y2_c3 = tensor_clamp_finite s_y2_exp
    in if ¬ check_exp_invertible s_y2_c3 then Err NumericFailure
       else case tensor_div y1 s_y2_c3 of 
              Err e ⇒ Err e 
            | Ok y1_new ⇒ Ok (tensor_clamp_finite y1_new, y2_new))"

definition compute_grad_scale :: "bool ⇒ nat ⇒ f32" where
  "compute_grad_scale grad_mean batch_size = (
    if grad_mean then f32_div f32_one (f32_from_nat batch_size) else f32_one)"

definition accumulate_grad :: "f32 list ⇒ f32 list ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32 list" where
  "accumulate_grad grad delta scale = map (λ(g, d). f32_add g (f32_mul d scale)) (zip grad delta)"

definition rsf_layer_backward :: "rsf_layer ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ 
  (tensor × tensor × tensor × tensor × rsf_layer) result" where
  "rsf_layer_backward layer y1 y2 dy1_in dy2_in = (
    case assert_pair layer y1 y2 of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok batch_size ⇒
    case assert_pair layer dy1_in dy2_in of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok _ ⇒
    let dy1 = tensor_copy dy1_in;
        dy2 = tensor_copy dy2_in;
        y1_t = tensor_transpose y1;
        t_y1_t = tensor_matmul (t_weight layer) y1_t;
        t_y1 = tensor_transpose t_y1_t;
        t_y1_bias = add_bias_batch t_y1 (data (t_bias layer)) batch_size (dim layer);
        t_y1_c = tensor_clamp_finite t_y1_bias
    in case tensor_sub y2 t_y1_c of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok x2_pre ⇒
    let x2 = tensor_clamp_finite x2_pre;
        dy2_t = tensor_transpose dy2;
        dt = tensor_matmul dy2_t y1;
        grad_scale = compute_grad_scale (layer_grad_mean layer) batch_size;
        new_t_weight_grad = t_weight_grad layer ⦇ data := accumulate_grad (data (t_weight_grad layer)) (data dt) grad_scale ⦈;
        t_bias_delta = concat (map (λi. data dy2) [0..<batch_size]);
        new_t_bias_grad = t_bias_grad layer ⦇ data := accumulate_grad (data (t_bias_grad layer)) t_bias_delta grad_scale ⦈;
        t_weight_t = tensor_transpose (t_weight layer);
        grad_from_t_t = tensor_matmul t_weight_t dy2_t;
        grad_from_t = tensor_transpose grad_from_t_t
    in case tensor_add dy1 grad_from_t of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok dy1_new_pre ⇒
    let dy1_new = tensor_clamp_finite dy1_new_pre;
        x2_t = tensor_transpose x2;
        s_pre_t = tensor_matmul (s_weight layer) x2_t;
        s_pre = tensor_transpose s_pre_t;
        s_pre_bias = add_bias_batch s_pre (data (s_bias layer)) batch_size (dim layer);
        s_pre_c = tensor_clamp_finite s_pre_bias;
        s_clipped = tensor_clip s_pre_c (layer_clip_min layer) (layer_clip_max layer);
        s_clipped_c = tensor_clamp_finite s_clipped;
        exp_s = tensor_exp s_clipped_c;
        exp_s_c = tensor_clamp_finite exp_s
    in if ¬ check_exp_invertible exp_s_c then Err NumericFailure
       else case tensor_div y1 exp_s_c of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok x1_pre ⇒
       let x1 = tensor_clamp_finite x1_pre;
           dx1 = x1 ⦇ data := map (λ(dy, ex). f32_mul dy ex) (zip (data dy1_new) (data exp_s_c)) ⦈;
           dscale = dy1_new ⦇ data := map (λ(dy, x). f32_mul dy x) (zip (data dy1_new) (data x1)) ⦈;
           ds = dscale ⦇ data := map (λ(ds, ex). f32_mul ds ex) (zip (data dscale) (data exp_s_c)) ⦈;
           ds_zeroed = ds ⦇ data := map (λi. 
             let b = i div dim layer; d = i mod dim;
                 v = data s_pre_c ! i;
                 ds_val = data ds ! i
             in if ¬ is_finite_f32 v ∨ f32_lt v (layer_clip_min layer) ∨ f32_lt (layer_clip_max layer) v 
                then f32_zero else ds_val) [0..<length (data ds)] ⦈;
           ds_t = tensor_transpose ds_zeroed;
           ds_w = tensor_matmul ds_t x2;
           new_s_weight_grad = s_weight_grad layer ⦇ data := accumulate_grad (data (s_weight_grad layer)) (data ds_w) grad_scale ⦈;
           s_bias_delta = concat (map (λi. data ds_zeroed) [0..<batch_size]);
           new_s_bias_grad = s_bias_grad layer ⦇ data := accumulate_grad (data (s_bias_grad layer)) s_bias_delta grad_scale ⦈;
           s_weight_t = tensor_transpose (s_weight layer);
           grad_from_s_t = tensor_matmul s_weight_t ds_t;
           grad_from_s = tensor_transpose grad_from_s_t
       in case tensor_add dy2 grad_from_s of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok dx2_pre ⇒
       let dx2 = tensor_clamp_finite dx2_pre;
           updated_layer = layer ⦇ s_weight_grad := new_s_weight_grad, t_weight_grad := new_t_weight_grad,
                                   s_bias_grad := new_s_bias_grad, t_bias_grad := new_t_bias_grad ⦈
       in Ok (x1, x2, tensor_clamp_finite dx1, dx2, updated_layer))"

record rsf_config =
  rsf_clip_min :: f32
  rsf_clip_max :: f32
  rsf_grad_mean :: bool
  max_dim :: nat
  max_layers :: nat

definition default_rsf_config :: rsf_config where
  "default_rsf_config = ⦇ rsf_clip_min = float_of RNE (-5), rsf_clip_max = float_of RNE 5,
    rsf_grad_mean = True, max_dim = 2^20, max_layers = 2^20 ⦈"

record rsf =
  rsf_dim :: nat
  num_layers :: nat
  layers :: "rsf_layer list"
  cfg :: rsf_config
  freed :: bool

definition rsf_init_with_config :: "nat ⇒ nat ⇒ rsf_config ⇒ rsf result" where
  "rsf_init_with_config d n cfg = (
    if d = 0 then Err InvalidDimension
    else if n = 0 then Err InvalidLayerCount
    else if d > max_dim cfg ∨ n > max_layers cfg then Err TooLarge
    else if ¬ is_finite_f32 (rsf_clip_min cfg) ∨ ¬ is_finite_f32 (rsf_clip_max cfg) then Err NonFinite
    else if ¬ f32_lt (rsf_clip_min cfg) (rsf_clip_max cfg) then Err InvalidConfig
    else
      let layer_cfg = ⦇ clip_min = rsf_clip_min cfg, clip_max = rsf_clip_max cfg, 
                        seed_offset = 0, grad_mean = rsf_grad_mean cfg ⦈;
          init_results = map (λi. rsf_layer_init_with_config d (layer_cfg ⦇ seed_offset := i * 1000 ⦈)) [0..<n]
      in if list_all is_ok init_results 
         then Ok ⦇ rsf_dim = d, num_layers = n, layers = map get_ok init_results, cfg = cfg, freed = False ⦈
         else Err (get_err (hd (filter (λr. ¬ is_ok r) init_results))))"

definition rsf_init :: "nat ⇒ nat ⇒ rsf result" where
  "rsf_init d n = rsf_init_with_config d n default_rsf_config"

definition rsf_deinit :: "rsf ⇒ rsf" where
  "rsf_deinit r = r ⦇ freed := True ⦈"

definition rsf_zero_gradients :: "rsf ⇒ rsf" where
  "rsf_zero_gradients r = r ⦇ layers := map rsf_layer_zero_gradients (layers r) ⦈"

definition split_tensor :: "tensor ⇒ nat ⇒ (tensor × tensor) result" where
  "split_tensor x d = (
    case assert_2d_and_len x of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok () ⇒
    if cols (shape x) ≠ d * 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
    else let batch_size = rows (shape x);
             x1_data = concat (map (λb. take d (drop (b * d * 2) (data x))) [0..<batch_size]);
             x2_data = concat (map (λb. take d (drop (b * d * 2 + d) (data x))) [0..<batch_size]);
             x1 = ⦇ shape = shape_2d batch_size d, data = x1_data ⦈;
             x2 = ⦇ shape = shape_2d batch_size d, data = x2_data ⦈
         in Ok (x1, x2))"

definition merge_tensor :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ nat ⇒ tensor result" where
  "merge_tensor x1 x2 d = (
    case assert_2d_and_len x1 of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok () ⇒
    case assert_2d_and_len x2 of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok () ⇒
    if rows (shape x1) ≠ rows (shape x2) then Err ShapeMismatch
    else if cols (shape x1) ≠ d ∨ cols (shape x2) ≠ d then Err ShapeMismatch
    else let batch_size = rows (shape x1);
             out_data = concat (map (λb. (take d (drop (b * d) (data x1))) @ (take d (drop (b * d) (data x2)))) [0..<batch_size]);
             out = ⦇ shape = shape_2d batch_size (d * 2), data = out_data ⦈
         in Ok out)"

definition rsf_forward :: "rsf ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor result" where
  "rsf_forward r x = (
    if freed r then Err NotInitialized
    else case assert_2d_and_len x of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok () ⇒
    if cols (shape x) ≠ rsf_dim r * 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
    else case split_tensor x (rsf_dim r) of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok (x1_init, x2_init) ⇒
    let forward_step = (λ(x1, x2) layer. 
          case rsf_layer_forward layer x1 x2 of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok res ⇒ Ok res);
        result = foldl (λacc layer. 
          case acc of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok (x1, x2) ⇒ forward_step (x1, x2) layer) 
          (Ok (x1_init, x2_init)) (layers r)
    in case result of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok (x1_final, x2_final) ⇒
       merge_tensor x1_final x2_final (rsf_dim r))"

definition rsf_inverse :: "rsf ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor result" where
  "rsf_inverse r y = (
    if freed r then Err NotInitialized
    else case assert_2d_and_len y of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok () ⇒
    if cols (shape y) ≠ rsf_dim r * 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
    else case split_tensor y (rsf_dim r) of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok (y1_init, y2_init) ⇒
    let inverse_step = (λ(y1, y2) layer. 
          case rsf_layer_inverse layer y1 y2 of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok res ⇒ Ok res);
        result = foldl (λacc layer. 
          case acc of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok (y1, y2) ⇒ inverse_step (y1, y2) layer) 
          (Ok (y1_init, y2_init)) (rev (layers r))
    in case result of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok (y1_final, y2_final) ⇒
       merge_tensor y1_final y2_final (rsf_dim r))"

definition rsf_backward :: "rsf ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor × rsf) result" where
  "rsf_backward r grad_output input = (
    if freed r then Err NotInitialized
    else case rsf_forward r input of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok y ⇒
    case split_tensor y (rsf_dim r) of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok (y1, y2) ⇒
    case split_tensor grad_output (rsf_dim r) of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok (dy1, dy2) ⇒
    let backward_step = (λ(cur_y1, cur_y2, cur_dy1, cur_dy2, lyrs, idx) unit.
          if idx = 0 then Ok (cur_dy1, cur_dy2, lyrs)
          else let layer = lyrs ! (idx - 1)
               in case rsf_layer_backward layer cur_y1 cur_y2 cur_dy1 cur_dy2 of 
                    Err e ⇒ Err e 
                  | Ok (x1_prev, x2_prev, dx1_prev, dx2_prev, updated_layer) ⇒
                    Ok (dx1_prev, dx2_prev, list_update lyrs (idx - 1) updated_layer));
        init_state = (y1, y2, dy1, dy2, layers r, num_layers r);
        final = foldl (λacc i. case acc of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok state ⇒ backward_step state ()) 
                      (Ok init_state) (rev [0..<num_layers r])
    in case final of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok (_, _, _, _, updated_layers, _) ⇒
       case merge_tensor dy1 dy2 (rsf_dim r) of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok grad_input ⇒
       Ok (grad_input, r ⦇ layers := updated_layers ⦈))"

datatype file_byte = Byte nat

definition write_u32_le :: "nat ⇒ file_byte list" where
  "write_u32_le n = [Byte (n mod 256), Byte ((n div 256) mod 256), 
                     Byte ((n div 65536) mod 256), Byte (n div 16777216)]"

definition write_u64_le :: "nat ⇒ file_byte list" where
  "write_u64_le n = (write_u32_le (n mod 4294967296)) @ (write_u32_le (n div 4294967296))"

definition write_f32_le :: "f32 ⇒ file_byte list" where
  "write_f32_le f = write_u32_le (nat (uint_of_float f))"

definition write_magic :: "file_byte list" where
  "write_magic = [Byte 82, Byte 83, Byte 70, Byte 48]"

definition rsf_save :: "rsf ⇒ file_byte list result" where
  "rsf_save r = (
    if freed r then Err NotInitialized
    else let header = write_magic @ write_u32_le 1 @ write_u64_le (num_layers r) @ write_u64_le (rsf_dim r)
                      @ write_f32_le (rsf_clip_min (cfg r)) @ write_f32_le (rsf_clip_max (cfg r))
                      @ [if rsf_grad_mean (cfg r) then Byte 1 else Byte 0];
             layer_data = concat (map (λlayer. 
               write_f32_le (layer_clip_min layer) @ write_f32_le (layer_clip_max layer) 
               @ [if layer_grad_mean layer then Byte 1 else Byte 0]
               @ concat (map write_f32_le (data (s_weight layer)))
               @ concat (map write_f32_le (data (t_weight layer)))
               @ concat (map write_f32_le (data (s_bias layer)))
               @ concat (map write_f32_le (data (t_bias layer)))) (layers r))
         in Ok (header @ layer_data))"

definition read_u32_le :: "file_byte list ⇒ (nat × file_byte list) option" where
  "read_u32_le bs = (
    if length bs < 4 then None
    else let b0 = (case bs ! 0 of Byte n ⇒ n);
             b1 = (case bs ! 1 of Byte n ⇒ n);
             b2 = (case bs ! 2 of Byte n ⇒ n);
             b3 = (case bs ! 3 of Byte n ⇒ n);
             val = b0 + b1 * 256 + b2 * 65536 + b3 * 16777216
         in Some (val, drop 4 bs))"

definition read_u64_le :: "file_byte list ⇒ (nat × file_byte list) option" where
  "read_u64_le bs = (
    case read_u32_le bs of None ⇒ None | Some (lo, bs1) ⇒
    case read_u32_le bs1 of None ⇒ None | Some (hi, bs2) ⇒
    Some (lo + hi * 4294967296, bs2))"

definition read_f32_le :: "file_byte list ⇒ (f32 × file_byte list) option" where
  "read_f32_le bs = (
    case read_u32_le bs of None ⇒ None | Some (n, bs1) ⇒
    Some (float_of_uint (int n), bs1))"

definition rsf_load :: "file_byte list ⇒ rsf result" where
  "rsf_load bs = (
    if length bs < 4 then Err BadFileFormat
    else if take 4 bs ≠ [Byte 82, Byte 83, Byte 70, Byte 48] then Err BadFileFormat
    else case read_u32_le (drop 4 bs) of None ⇒ Err BadFileFormat | Some (version, bs1) ⇒
    if version ≠ 1 then Err UnsupportedVersion
    else case read_u64_le bs1 of None ⇒ Err BadFileFormat | Some (n, bs2) ⇒
    case read_u64_le bs2 of None ⇒ Err BadFileFormat | Some (d, bs3) ⇒
    if n = 0 ∨ d = 0 then Err InvalidDimension
    else if n > 2^20 ∨ d > 2^20 then Err TooLarge
    else case read_f32_le bs3 of None ⇒ Err BadFileFormat | Some (cmin, bs4) ⇒
    case read_f32_le bs4 of None ⇒ Err BadFileFormat | Some (cmax, bs5) ⇒
    if ¬ is_finite_f32 cmin ∨ ¬ is_finite_f32 cmax ∨ ¬ f32_lt cmin cmax then Err InvalidConfig
    else if length bs5 < 1 then Err BadFileFormat
    else let gm = (case bs5 ! 0 of Byte n ⇒ n ≠ 0);
             cfg = ⦇ rsf_clip_min = cmin, rsf_clip_max = cmax, rsf_grad_mean = gm, 
                     max_dim = 2^20, max_layers = 2^20 ⦈
         in case rsf_init_with_config d n cfg of Err e ⇒ Err e | Ok r ⇒ Ok r)"
```
